title: Cost hurdle: implied must exceed realized vol by ~15%
detail: Python engine (research/vrp_engine.py, 7 tests passing) run on synthetic GBM markets with known implied and realized vol, H1 rules and costs. Break-even implied/realized ratio is about 1.15 at both 10% and 15% realized vol. At 1.00 (no premium) the book loses 8-9% a year while still winning 80% of days, so win rate is not evidence for this structure. At 1.20 it earns about 2.5-3.4% a year, at 1.40 about 10-11%. Consequence: a VIX1D anchor bias of 10% is enough to fake an edge, so the anchor check runs before H1. Synthetic markets have no jumps or fat tails, so this is a cost hurdle, not a tail-risk estimate.
